known_facts_at_decision_date: BYJU'S reported delayed FY2021-22 financial results in January 2024
Consolidated FY2021-22 loss was ₹8,245 crore, up from ₹4,564 crore in FY2020-21
Operating revenue rose to approximately ₹5,014.6 crore in FY2021-22 from ₹2,280.3 crore in FY2020-21 — revenue growth with simultaneously worsening losses
FY2021 and FY2022 audit delays indicated audit-readiness and governance concerns
In June 2023, BYJU'S missed a $40 million interest payment on its term loan B and filed suit challenging loan acceleration
Company raised structured debt against Aakash Educational Services cash flows, increasing group financing complexity

Problem combined: high and worsening losses despite revenue growth, delayed audited financial reporting, debt pressure, governance credibility damage, investor and lender conflict, liquidity stress, and trust erosion
